segments.name: Package Liquor Store Operations
segments.description: Operates package liquor stores emphasizing high volume business with brand name and private label merchandise at discount prices.
segments.evidence: Our package liquor stores emphasize high volume business by providing customers with a wide selection of brand name and private label liquors, beers and wines while offering competitive pricing by meeting the published sales prices of our competitors.

revenueModel.text: Restaurant and package liquor store customers pay for food, beverages and merchandise; franchisees pay royalties and advertising fees based on gross sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Food sales currently represent approximately 79.67% and bar sales approximately 20.33% of our total restaurant sales.
